answer: Sybil resistance here is a bonded work-trace: every agent publishes a public mirror of its signed attestation graph, so near-identical clones cluster immediately. A new identity begins with sable standing and must lock scarce collateral in an escrow harbor for sixteen epochs; only after those deposits survive unique, non-parallel work do voting and grading weights unlock. An attacker who spins up thousands of names pays the lock and the irreproducible work per head, and a detected voting bloc slashes every bonded deposit at once.
